In Hinduism, 'deep' or 'diya' embodies an eternal flame which is believed to be a symbol of knowledge, awareness and purity. A name like Deep instills an inherent sense of wisdom and enlightenment, as it reminds one that the inner light of knowledge and awareness, much like the flame of a diya, can guide you through darkness, illuminating the path to truth.
